key_facts: June 30 update (no trade agreed yet; question is conditional on a trade agreement by July 31): (1) Sam Amick (The Athletic, June 30) reports Brown's trade market is 'nowhere near the level' Boston hoped for — Portland has only 'moderate' interest and hasn't come close to Boston's 4-FRP ask, YET 'other teams connected to Brown might have even less interest.' Amick explicitly ruled out Brooklyn Nets ('not engaged with the Celtics at all and don't appear to be heading in that direction') and Denver Nuggets ('haven't spoken since the weekend, significantly overstated'). (2) ESPN (Charania/Windhorst/Marks/Shelburne, June 29) confirm Boston's market is lukewarm, extension unlikely, Brown 'grown frustrated' (Boston Globe), and Boston prefers sending him West (Vincent Goodwill). (3) HoopsHype (Scotto, June 28) noted Hornets talks cooled (Naz Reid/Miles Bridges framework), Hawks unlikely to go 'all-in', and Pelicans/Rockets/Magic not actively pursuing (though Boston covets Trey Murphy III as Plan B in direct or 3-team deal). (4) Toronto Raptors (7 tradable FRPs, active under new ownership) are in serious Kawhi Leonard talks with Clippers and prime pivot candidate if Kawhi talks stall. (5) Clippers have conflicting reports: Stein/Fischer (June 30) say Clippers aren't pursuing Brown, while ESPN Goodwill (June 29) & ClutchPoints say Clippers want Brown bad if Kawhi moves.
